title: Babylonian King List of the Hellenistic Period (BM 35603) — Livius.org (trans. R. J. van der Spek)

verification_log.method: Rev. 9–10: year 137, Ulûlu: Seleucus IV died and Antiochus (IV) ascended the throne the same month, reigning eleven years; rev. 11–13: co-regency with a son, killed in year 142; rev. 14: year 148, Kislîmu: "it was heard that" Antiochus (IV) the king died

access_notes: The page warns that the translation needs revision and some restorations are uncertain; "son" in rev. 10 is not literal (Antiochus IV was Seleucus IV's brother).
